columns.name: ALLOW_MULTIPLE_RE_TAKES
columns.description: A flag indicating if a user can take the survey multiple times.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: DISPLAY_END_DATE
columns.description: This has been deprecated from the schema.

columns.name: DISPLAY_START_DATE
columns.description: This has been deprecated from the schema.

columns.name: PUBLISHED
columns.description: A flag indicating the survey is published.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID for the repository or view the survey is associated with

columns.name: SURVEY_TYPE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID to the type of servey.

columns.name: REFERENCE_KEY
columns.description: Locale independent name for the record. Translated localized versions of the reference key are stored in property files and in table with names ending in RESOURCe.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID for the user associated with this record.

columns.name: EMAIL_CONTENT
columns.description: A flag indicating that the answer content should be included in the email notification.

columns.name: RATING_TYPE
columns.description: 0=custom rating (the old way of doing ratings), 1=YES rating, 2=YES/NO rating, 3=3 stars, 4=5 stars.

columns.name: REVERSE_RATING_ORDER
columns.description: Indicator that controls the display order of the rating. 1=reverse order, 0=ascending order.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
